Definition
[Transplanted Euclidean heat kernel] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0238 \group Parametrix

For $d(x,y)<\operatorname {inj}(g)$ set \[ E(x,t;y,u):=(4\pi (t-u))^{-n/2} \exp \! \left(-\frac{d(x,y)^2}{4(t-u)}\right). \] It is smooth off the cut locus and is the Euclidean heat kernel when $\mathcal M=\mathbb R^n$.
